Subject: Post-demo: Champion & purchase path — requested org scan

Hi Chris — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a few asks so we keep momentum: 

- Summary: We showed Redwood inference runtime, predictable latency guarantees for small-batch interactive traffic, and a cost/throughput comparison for the two topologies you mentioned (hosted vs dedicated). You said Priya and Marcus were excited about the perf numbers.

- Ask 1 (org mapping): Could you share a simple org sketch (who's sponsoring internally, economic buyer, procurement, legal) and any names/emails you prefer we loop in for procurement questions? If it's easier, a quick screenshot or diagram is fine.

- Ask 2 (decision criteria): Can you confirm the top 3 must-haves for the evaluation (e.g., data residency, SOC 2 evidence, SLA/uptime, cost per token targets)? We want to tailor the follow-ups and the eval plan.

- Ask 3 (timeline): Do you have a target decision window / procurement timeline? Are there scheduled Q3 budgeting cutoffs we should be aware of?

Attached: demo-deck.pdf (slides from today's session).

Next steps I propose: you share the org sketch → we identify the champion & econ buyer → Redwood prepares SOC2 pack + a procurement-ready one-pager and suggested commercial options (hosted vs dedicated).

I can do a short next call if you want to walk the org map together.

Thanks,
Ben

- Org sketch: attaching acme-org-sketch.png. High level: Priya Sharma (Head of ML) is the technical champion. Economic buyer is Marcus Lee (CTO). Procurement goes through Sarah Procurement (sarah.procure@acme.com). Legal is handled by the central legal group (legal@acme.com) — they'll ask for our standard vendor security pack.

- Decision criteria: Marcus highlighted latency under p95 for 2k token sessions, predictable monthly spend (we can't have >20% month-over-month surprise), and data isolation options for PII workloads. SOC 2 + DPA will be table stakes.

- Timeline: We're shooting for a vendor shortlist by end of June and contracting in mid-July, ideally. Budget conversation with Marcus early next week. Priya's looped here and can help with technical Qs.

If you can send a concise procurement packet (SOC2, DPA, sample contract terms, and a one-page commercial), I'll route to Sarah and Legal. Happy to do a 15-min intro with Marcus if you want him briefed before procurement.

Thanks,
Chris

Thanks Ben — good capture. Quick plan and next steps from my side: 

1) Procurement packet (I will own) — deliverables by EOD Monday: 
  - SOC 2 summary + redacted attestation (PDF)
  - DPA + short explainer (one pager)
  - Data retention & deletion policy excerpt (one pager)
  - One-page "Commercial options & tech tradeoffs" (hosted vs dedicated) tailored to Acme's latency + isolation asks

2) Legal flags to expect: our standard DPA has a section on subprocessors and liability caps. If Legal pushes on liability we typically scope by use-case and offer higher SLA/limits under Dedicated. I'll include recommended language and a redline-ready DPA.

3) Intro approach: I recommend this sequence —
  a) Ben -> Marcus (CTO) intro with one-paragraph value summary + ask for budget window (Ben to send)
  b) Ben + Jasmine -> Priya (technical) to schedule a 30-min technical validation (latency testing plan)
  c) Ben -> Sarah Procurement + legal@acme.com with the procurement packet attached
